description: This file defines a PHP class 'LdapConfigurationController' that extends an abstract controller for Vue-based front-end integration. It handles LDAP configuration in the OrangeHRM system, particularly preparing data for rendering LDAP settings in a web component.

classes.name: LdapConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for managing LDAP configuration in the admin plugin. It prepares LDAP settings for rendering in the front-end Vue component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data before rendering the LDAP configuration component, fetching LDAP settings and setting component properties based on LDAP enablement.
